RegistrationInfo.Description: W365 thin client YOLO (SCRIPT-FREE, Oct 13 2026): ONE task, SIX event triggers, all firing rwinsta.exe console. PRINCIPAL (per Bruce, Oct 13): BUILTIN\Users group with LogonType InteractiveToken - "run only when a user is logged on"; the task cannot fire at a logged-off logon screen. Trade: the action now runs with the logged-on user's token instead of LOCAL SYSTEM, so rwinsta-as-user is the unproven bit - if the action errors in pilot, revert the principal to S-1-5-18. Triggers: Power-Troubleshooter 1 (wake), Kernel-Power 107 (Sx resume), Kernel-Power 507 exit with Reason Lid(15)/Power Button(1)/Battery Drain Budget Exceeded(55) and NO duration floor, ClientActiveXCore 1026 (RDP disconnected, Operational log), ClientActiveXCore 1019 UNFILTERED (Analytic log - its payload is a single TraceMessage string, so it cannot be narrowed by XPath; ANY client error fires this), and ClientActiveXCore 1003 filtered to the disconnect-reason trace point Value=4616 / 0x1208 'PC went to sleep' (Analytic log). OPEN GATES: (1) Task Scheduler may refuse the two Analytic-channel subscriptions at import - that refusal is itself a result; if import fails, remove the 1019/1003 triggers and re-import. (2) The unfiltered 1019 is the prune candidate if it false-fires; 1003-filtered does its job precisely. Built at Bruce's direction Oct 13, 2026.

EventTrigger.Subscription: <QueryList><Query Id="0" Path="System"><Select Path="System">*[System[Provider[@Name='Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-Power'] and (EventID=507)] and EventData[(Data[@Name='Reason']=15 or Data[@Name='Reason']=1 or Data[@Name='Reason']=55)]]</Select></Query></QueryList>
